newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany hails peaceful Chechen election.
newsitem.headline: Germany hails peaceful Chechen election.

text.p: Germany on Wednesday hailed the peaceful and orderly nature of presidential elections in Chechnya, saying the poll laid the foundations to continue the peace process in the breakaway region.
"The elections show that the path chosen by Russia of seeking a political solution to the conflict in Chechnya is progressing successfully," Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said in a statement.
"I encourage the Russian government to continue on its chosen path with the elected Chechen president," he said.
Kinkel also praised the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe for overseeing Monday's elections.
Aslan Maskhadov, a guerrilla leader who wants Russia and the world to recognise Chechen independence, has already claimed victory, although the final official results have still to be announced.
